note: Identity CLASSES only. Concrete account names, current bindings and project details are in the private record (Sector_Ops 19). Nothing here changes IAM; every step needs its own approval and a passing denial probe before the next starts.

shared-writer.what: the one runtime identity used today by the Orchestrator, the Lake and Water Temperature jobs, and the Brains the Orchestrator runs in process (biological-state, sector-intelligence)

brain-job.what: one per Brain job (water-clarity already has its own)

publisher.what: the central Publisher (pilot tool today; brain-publisher job after approval)

orchestrator.what: brain-orchestrator once nothing else shares its identity

scorer.what: the shared scorer (runs inside the Orchestrator today)

targetExceptions.biological-state: LEGACY_COMBINED: stays on its direct writer, unchanged, until the approved Fish/Biological split (Cortex BA-04, M01-M03); then fish-knowledge and fish-behavior get brain-job identities and the shared writer is retired

steps.what: water-clarity job on its own read-only identity
steps.denialProbe: the job identity's database write is denied

steps.gate: Sector_Ops 19: approve the recurring Publisher service
steps.denialProbe: the publisher identity cannot create under artifacts/ or exports/ and cannot delete history

steps.what: brain-publisher live for water-clarity; the Orchestrator writes publication requests and starts the job
steps.gate: Sector_Ops 18 D1 + D2 (release approval) and an Orchestrator change (decision-required)
steps.denialProbe: X16 for water-clarity: specialist, Ops and a cross-domain identity denied; publisher allowed

steps.what: wind-hourly moves to a brain-job identity at the Wind cutover
steps.gate: Wind 7-day shadow equivalence + Wind cutover approval
steps.denialProbe: the Wind job identity's database write is denied

steps.what: water-temp-brain moves off the shared writer to a brain-job identity
steps.denialProbe: the Water Temp job identity's database write is denied

steps.what: lake-brain moves off the shared writer to a brain-job identity
steps.gate: Lake cutover plan approval (and Sector_Ops 22 contract decisions)
steps.denialProbe: the Lake job identity's database write is denied

steps.what: sector-intelligence stops writing in process; it emits an artifact and the Publisher publishes it
steps.denialProbe: no Brain path appears in the Orchestrator's own writes for sector-intelligence (code pin)

steps.what: the Orchestrator gets its own orchestrator identity; the shared writer is left with biological-state only
steps.gate: owner approval; decision O-ID (how platform-only writes are enforced, see the plan document)
steps.denialProbe: Lake/Water Temp/Intelligence jobs can no longer act as the shared writer

steps.what: after the Fish/Biological split: fish-knowledge and fish-behavior on brain-job identities; the shared writer is deleted
steps.denialProbe: the shared writer no longer exists
